paragraphs: Kajeet sells managed cellular connectivity as one stack covering devices, networks and locations. The Sentinel platform is the console where operators activate devices, apply policy and monitor a fleet across deployments. Connectivity itself runs on Kajeet smartSIM, a single eSIM that switches among carrier networks without a manual SIM swap.

SmartFailover is sold as a backup internet path that takes over when the primary wired connection drops. Kajeet fixed wireless covers sites that use cellular service as a primary connection, shipped preconfigured for self-install. Hotspots that can be signed out to students, along with kitting and provisioning services, round out what Kajeet offers.

Kajeet names school districts, health systems, transit agencies, public libraries and enterprise fleets among the deployments its platform reaches. Education connectivity is described as CIPA-compliant, for students wherever learning takes place. Resellers and managed service providers are offered the fixed wireless product to add to client portfolios.

quote.text: Kajeet brings connectivity, device management, network intelligence, and managed services together in one unified platform
